en: Typhoon Haiyan, known locally as Yolanda, was one of the strongest tropical cyclones to make landfall in the Philippines in 2013.
Baguio City experiences a subtropical highland climate, making it significantly cooler than the rest of the Philippines year-round.
The fertile loam soil of the Cagayan Valley is highly suitable for growing major crops like corn and rice.
Pumice is a lightweight volcanic rock that contains so many gas bubbles it can temporarily float on water.
Talc is the softest mineral on the Mohs hardness scale and is the main ingredient in baby powder.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River in Palawan features an underground river that flows directly through a cave into the sea.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a massive, persistent anticyclonic storm that is actually larger than the planet Earth.
Titan is the largest moon of Saturn and the only moon in our solar system with a dense atmosphere.
Sirius, located in the Canis Major constellation, is the brightest star visible in the Earth's night sky.
The Sea of Tranquility is a large lunar mare on the Moon where the Apollo 11 astronauts first landed.
The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo was the second-largest volcanic eruption of the twentieth century.
The 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami was one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history.
